connectors.warning: A catalog name is not an adapter. Verified connection requires explicit provider auth, capability coverage, real operations and recovery.

items.title: Build project digital twins
items.implementationClaim: Current twin is an illustrative queueing/capacity scenario, not a measured software/infrastructure replica.
originalRequirements: Predictions are calibrated against real staging outcomes and documented uncertainty.
Twin changes cannot affect production or expose sensitive data.

items.title: Add cost and revenue impact models
items.implementationClaim: No real billing, unit economics or revenue model is connected.
originalRequirements: Scenarios trace to real input data and explicitly distinguish forecasts from facts.
Revenue and cost access is permission-controlled.

items.title: Replace future-state templates with evaluated plans
items.implementationClaim: V2/V3/V5/V10 are disclosed planning templates informed by snapshot gaps.
originalRequirements: Every horizon has project-specific evidence and testable milestones.
Predictions remain hypotheses with evaluations, not guaranteed futures.

items.title: Connect product and business intelligence
items.implementationClaim: No real customer, product, market, revenue or competitor evidence is ingested.
originalRequirements: Recommendations reference real evidence and measurable business objectives.
Sensitive business/customer data has scoped access and retention.

items.title: Build innovation discovery and validation
items.implementationClaim: Innovation Discovery is a catalog domain; no invention pipeline or novelty evaluation exists.
originalRequirements: Proposals include sources, competing solutions, validation plans and experimental results.
The system does not claim that nobody has built something without evidence.

items.title: Complete executive intelligence scores
items.implementationClaim: Seven heuristic scores exist; no complete executive scorecard or measured business readiness exists.
originalRequirements: All 14 dimensions have documented methodology and evidence or an explicit unassessed state.
A score never implies a certification or unsupported measurement.

items.title: Complete accessibility and responsive verification
items.implementationClaim: Responsive styles and component primitives exist; no measured accessibility audit is complete.
originalRequirements: Representative viewport and assistive-technology journeys pass with recorded findings.
All critical actions work without a mouse.

items.title: Implement scoped compliance and legal auditing
items.implementationClaim: Compliance and Legal Auditing are domain definitions; there are no evidence collectors or jurisdiction-specific controls.
originalRequirements: Reports distinguish measured controls, missing evidence and legal interpretation.
No unsupported certification or legal conclusion is issued.

items.title: Create reusable integration execution contracts
items.implementationClaim: Catalog registrations do not connect systems; only bounded GitHub/snapshot adapters have execution code.
originalRequirements: Every adapter follows a verified lifecycle and common capability/error contract.
Cross-source permission boundaries and revoked access are enforced.

items.title: Prepare release documentation and operating evidence
items.implementationClaim: README, architecture status and evidence files exist, but full operating/developer documentation is incomplete.
originalRequirements: A new authorized operator can set up, verify, recover and upgrade the platform using the docs.
Release notes accurately distinguish engineering work, activation and verification.

items.title: Resolve the unused Vercel experiment
items.implementationClaim: An empty optional worker project was created; sandbox creation returned 403 and no running worker/deployment was established.
originalRequirements: No unwanted running resources or required Vercel dependency remain.
Cleanup outcome is verified; absence of a supported delete operation is documented.

items.title: GitHub integration
items.implementationClaim: Bounded snapshot ingestion and OAuth adapter implemented; live consent and advanced sync/CI remain unverified.
originalRequirements: Authorized real-source discovery and incremental read-back are demonstrated.
Denial, revocation, service failure and unsupported actions fail safely.
Writes, if shipped, have separate target-specific tests and policy.
